history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN: no web source uses the name 'Saiha Durga Temple'. Two plausible referents exist in Saiha, neither confirmed as this record's target: (1) the Kali Mandir at New Colony Veng (PIN 796901) - Kali is a form of Durga/Shakti, and this Bengali-community temple is the only goddess shrine in Saiha with any published write-up (one crowdsourced listing claims c.1940 origins, itself unverified); (2) the 'Sarvajanin Temple' at the Assam Rifles Complex, Saihatlangkawn Rd, Saiha - a Google Maps listing (4.5 rating, 19 reviews) whose 'Sarvajanin' name strongly suggests a community Durga Puja venue, but whose deity could not be verified from any readable page. Note a Durga Mandir is documented at Serchhip (a different town) - do not conflate. Treat this entry as provisional pending local confirmation.

name: Saiha Durga Temple
town_description: Saiha (officially Siaha) is the district headquarters of Saiha district in southern Mizoram, near the Myanmar border, and the principal town of the Mara Autonomous District Council. Home to the Mara tribe, who are overwhelmingly Christian, it is one of Mizoram's fastest-growing towns. A small Hindu minority - Bengali traders, government staff and paramilitary personnel - maintains the town's few community temples.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl), approx. 300-315 km by road / about 5 hours (verify). Pawan Hans helicopter service links Aizawl and Saiha (verify current operation).
travel.railway: Nearest railhead not reliably published (verify); candidates include Bairabi (Mizoram) and Ambassa/Dharmanagar (Tripura).
travel.road: Approx. 378 km from Aizawl via NH 54 (per Wikipedia), with regular buses and jeeps.
